plan.rationale: Frozen task is single-device FP32 ResNet-18 inference under torch.inference_mode (resnet_inference.py:14-16); request.json lists one GPU with distributed_backend=null and observations.json marks the communication capability not_applicable with zero cross-rank matches, so all communication-oriented collection is excluded. The torch collector already ran and coverage.json shows complete attribution (cuda_kernels=88, associated_kernels=88, unassociated=0, ambiguous_forward_sequences=0, autograd_ranges=0, backward_associated_kernels=0); the workload is eager single-stream inference with no CUDA graphs and no NCCL kernels, so no open overlap, graph-tracing, or attribution question justifies a separate nsys run. The objective minimizes peak_allocated_bytes subject to images_per_second >= 0.95x baseline with logits/top1 fidelity at atol=rtol=1e-4, so the plan selects: candidate_diagnostics to measure candidate variants' peak_allocated_bytes, images_per_second, and logits/top1 against the frozen correctness schema; execution_timeline for CPU-to-CUDA submit association, synchronization/workload boundaries, and per-device intervals on an unperturbed run, quantifying host-side gaps and boundary placement (its clock alignment bounds cover CPU submissions only, never replacing a communication hook or driving search actions); python_runtime for a warmed cProfile of host dispatch and binding costs that would absorb candidate-added Python overhead (it perturbs execution; inclusive/self times are diagnostic only, not clean performance scores or GPU compute durations); device_telemetry for device-wide NVML memory and utilization samples in native windows to corroborate allocator peaks against device memory and compute-saturation headroom for the throughput floor (PCIe rates deliberately not requested: device_telemetry is not per-collective or per-op bytes and inputs are GPU-resident). torch is not re-requested because it already ran; nsys and collective_calibration are omitted per the evidence above. Missing fields remain unknown: the framework verifies availability and retains them as unknown.
